content:
maria: Quick proposal — add a 'delta preview' step for staged overrides in Console. It would show the exact config diff per-route + an estimated delta for QPS, p50/p95, and token cost before you hit apply. Thoughts?
kevin: Love the idea. Two concerns: (1) how we compute cost/latency deltas accurately, (2) perf of running the preview for large rollout scopes.
jay: For perf, make preview sampled by default (e.g., 0.1% of keys) and allow full simulation for small cohorts.
sophie: We should wire preview to live telemetry predicates — show where the current SLOs are closest to breach and highlight risky routes. Default UI should mark "high-risk" changes. :warning:
lina: UX note — show example traces and top-5 affected customer ids (hashed) so PMs/SEs can triage. Also allow exporting the diff as JSON for runbooks.
maria: Agreed on sampling. For cost estimation we can use model cost profiles + prefix-cache hit rates. Those vary by route though.
kevin: Can we run a dry-run API that replays a day's worth of routing decisions against the new config? Not live traffic, just simulate on stored decision logs.
sophie: Yes — we already persist routing decisions in the routing-audit table. A dry-run worker could replay them and produce metrics. We need a quota on replay budget.
jay: Proposed API sketch:
```http
POST /internal/configs/dry-run
{
  "config_id": "cfg_abc123",
  "time_window": "2026-03-17T00:00:00Z/2026-03-18T00:00:00Z",
  "sampling_rate": 0.001
}
```
ops-bot: [automated] Note: dry-run jobs will be queued and billed to team's preview budget. Use `X-Preview-Project` header.
lina: How do we show uncertainty? Add a confidence band for cost/latency (e.g., +/-) and the sample size used.
maria: Good point. Also add "rollback-suggested" flag — if simulated p95 increases by >20% for routes with >100 qps, suggest auto-rollback on rollout.
kevin: Implementation detail: do simulation in two phases — cheap estimate (model-profile lookup + cached hit rates), then optional heavy replay for precise numbers.
sophie: For telemetry gating, let's add a preflight predicate: if dry-run indicates >5% user-impact above threshold, block rollout by default. Allow override with a required justification.
jay: We'll need console changes: preview diff panel, estimated metrics, sample traces, and a toggle to run heavy replay. Also add an expandable section showing the exact config delta in human-readable and machine JSON.
maria: Ops checklist: (1) endpoint to enqueue dry-run, (2) worker that reads routing-audit, (3) estimator service for quick previews, (4) UI components.
kevin: Security/PII: when displaying example traces / customer ids, always hash and salt per-org. No raw IDs.
deploy-bot: [automated] FYI: Any rollout with "rollback-suggested" will create a follow-up alert in ops channel and attach the dry-run report.
lina: Can we add cost estimates per token band (short/medium/long) since customers' token mix changes cost?
sophie: Yes — estimator should return bucketed token cost breakdowns.
maria: Next steps — I'll draft an RFC with API shapes, sampling defaults, and UI mockups. @kevin @lina please review and add concerns. Plan: prototype estimator + tiny UI widget for the canary next week. :rocket:
